data.label: Start Account Monitoring
data.description: Begin monitoring existing customer accounts for churn-risk signals in the CRM domain.

data.label: Collect Usage Signals
data.description: Gather product usage data and measure any drop over the last 30 days.

data.label: Check Support Sentiment
data.description: Identify support tickets tagged with negative sentiment for each account.

data.label: Check Payment Status
data.description: Detect late or failed invoice payments associated with each account.

data.label: Score Churn Risk
data.description: Combine usage, support, and billing signals to assign a churn-risk score from 0 to 100.

data.label: Handle High Risk Account
data.description: Process accounts with churn-risk scores above 75 for immediate intervention.

data.label: Notify CSM
data.description: Immediately notify the assigned Customer Success Manager about the high-risk account.

data.label: Draft Retention Email
data.description: Create a personalized retention outreach email for the Customer Success Manager to use.

data.label: Handle Medium Risk Account
data.description: Process accounts with churn-risk scores between 40 and 75 for review planning.

data.label: Queue Weekly Review
data.description: Add the account to the weekly Customer Success Manager review queue.

data.label: Continue Passive Monitoring
data.description: Keep monitoring accounts with churn-risk scores below 40 without escalation.

data.label: Log Scoring Decision
data.description: Record the churn-risk score and input signals used for audit purposes.

message: The workflow monitors customer account signals, scores churn risk, then routes accounts into high-risk escalation, medium-risk review, or low-risk passive monitoring while logging each decision for audit.

workflow.workflowBrief: Monitor existing customer accounts for churn-risk signals: drop in product usage over the last 30 days, support tickets tagged negative-sentiment, and late or failed invoice payments. Score each account's churn risk from 0 to 100. For scores above 75, immediately notify the assigned Customer Success Manager and draft a personalized retention outreach email. For scores between 40 and 75, add the account to a weekly CSM review queue. For scores below 40, continue passive monitoring. Log every scoring decision with the input signals for audit.
